name: Demoscene fire
doc: Classic cellular fire: a heat grid fed along its bottom edge, each cell the average of the cells below minus a scrolling noisy cooling, coloured through the palette. Bass feeds the fuel and raises the flames; onsets flare and throw fireballs.

palette.doc: coldest to hottest; stop 0 should be black

cells.doc: grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

steps.doc: sim steps per tick: rise speed

bass.doc: how much bass adds fuel and height
